newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch travel agents to sue KLM over fee cut.
newsitem.headline: Dutch travel agents to sue KLM over fee cut.

text.p: The Dutch association of travel agents ANVR said on Tuesday it would take KLM Royal Dutch Airlines to court over its decision to cut travel agents' commissions.
"The ANVR travel agents are very disappointed at the unilateral way that the cut of base commissions was announced on January 16," the association said.
KLM announced last month it would cut travel agents' fees to 7.5 percent per ticket from April 1. Presently it pays a nine percent commission.
ANVR said this would cut the agents' income by about 16 percent. The reduction would be added to the income fall resulting from consistent cuts in ticket prices over recent years.
The association said it had informed KLM in writing about its plans to take legal action, adding that talks with the Dutch flag carrier about the cuts in commission rates had produced no results.
